patch_description: Add a deterministic strict-improvement polishing phase after each long survivor refinement. The maximin objective is nonsmooth: annealing often reaches a good basin but stops with a small set of nearly active triangles limiting the score. This edit explicitly identifies vertices occurring in the lowest-area triangles and probes geometry-aware directions (cardinal/diagonal, radial, and tangential) at decreasing scales. Every accepted move must strictly improve the actual normalized minimum triangle area, so it cannot degrade the primary metric. The bounded stencil pass concentrates extra evaluations only on the four already-selected survivors.
